plan: Drive: from District of Vanderhoof, about 118 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 16, Blackwater Rd, Bobtail FSR, Bobtail Grizzly FSR.
Park: 53.24152, -123.58809, pull off on Alec Meadow Rd (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 6.2 km SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 99 m, about 134 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 110 m W of the spot at 895 m (53.21762, -123.6741). Water: unnamed wetland 30 m N (estimate).
Hunt: moose, season: VERIFY. Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-13, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-06, closures 2026-10-16.
